factor_policy: equal vote across fixed 85 registry factors; orientation from train-only label covariance; ties CASH
exposure_control: seeded Bernoulli; p from train momentum LONG fraction; not claimed Full-exposure-matched
feature_scope: price/indicators versus same price plus all 85 alpha candidates and verified sentiment/missingness

ledger: fractional, no tax/interest/settlement/fill constraints; daily close MTM; continuous hold comparator from first entry to final exit
